gear_ratio.label: Gear Ratio
gear_ratio.description: Motor turns per joint turn (N:1), from the joint's gearbox or transmission. Set by the deploy from the joint.

can_id.label: CAN ID
can_id.description: The driver's CAN ID (its CanID menu setting), 1–2047. Derived from the driver's place on the bus chain: 1 for the first after the CAN HAT, then 2, 3 …

channel.label: CAN Channel
channel.description: The SocketCAN interface the bus is on: can0 for the HAT's channel A, can1 for channel B.

invert.label: Invert Direction
invert.description: Flip the motor's direction when the joint moves the wrong way on first power-up.

move_speed_rpm.label: Move Speed (motor RPM)
move_speed_rpm.description: Motor speed for a position move that doesn't name one.

acceleration.label: Acceleration (0–255)
acceleration.description: The driver's acceleration setting: higher ramps faster; 0 runs at speed with no ramp.

zero_on_start.label: Zero On Start
zero_on_start.description: Take the position at startup as the joint's zero. Off: the driver's power-on position is the zero.
